intro.penguins: The road north runs through the orchards, and the orchards are full of grumps. Push them out row by row.
intro.gangsters: The President's lookouts have the orchard road. Every row of trees hides a parked car. Push them out, row by row.

won.penguins: The orchard road is open. The trees seem to stand a little straighter.
won.gangsters: The orchard road is ours. The lookouts drove off in a hurry, and the pickers are waving from the ladders.

nodes.name: Bramble Gap
nodes.brief: Abandoned stores. Take the supplies for the next fight, or share them with the locals for morale.

brief.penguins: A quick clash at Fallen Fence. Take the points and their line breaks.
brief.gangsters: Their lookouts hold Fallen Fence. Take the corners and they pull out.

brief.penguins: Captain Bramblesnout holds Honey Cellars. Turn the captain back and the rest will scatter, back to their gate.
brief.gangsters: Harlan "Hayride" Voss runs Fruit Stand. Make them back off and the crew falls back to their last block.

brief.penguins: The Cider Press: the last wall before the region. Every point fortified, and Captain Bramblesnout takes the field.
brief.gangsters: The Cider Works: the last block before the turf. Every point locked down, and Harlan "Hayride" Voss steps in.

steps: Help the orchard keeper mend the back fence
Follow the pickers' path round the rows
long_way.text: The orchard keeper knows a pickers' path round the back rows. Mend her fence first and she'll walk you through.
long_way.text_gang: The old orchard keeper hates the lookouts too. Fix her fence and she'll show you the farm track nobody watches.

sense.penguins: Branches creak where there's no wind, and small grumpy eyes blink from every orchard row.
sense.gangsters: A car with its lights off sits at the top of the orchard road. Then you spot a second one.

intro.penguins: The highland passes are held by wolves and winter wisps. Climb, hold the ledges, and the high country opens.
intro.gangsters: Up on the ridge the President's crews watch every switchback. Climb, take the lookouts, and the high country is open.

won.penguins: The highland gate swings open. The wind up here sounds almost friendly now.
won.gangsters: The high gate is ours. Up here the radio finally gets a signal, and it's playing our song.

brief.penguins: A quick clash at Wolf Run. Take the points and their line breaks.
brief.gangsters: Their lookouts hold Switchback One. Take the corners and they pull out.

brief.penguins: A quick clash at Cairn Field. Take the points and their line breaks.
brief.gangsters: Their lookouts hold Cairn Lay-by. Take the corners and they pull out.

brief.penguins: Shepherd's Hut is dug in and fortified: their points take twice as long to turn. Bring helpers and a plan.
brief.gangsters: Shepherd's Hut is locked down: their points take twice as long to turn. Bring the crew and a plan.

brief.penguins: Frostjaw holds Windy Saddle. Turn the captain back and the rest will scatter, back to their gate.
brief.gangsters: Ridge Boss Kestrel runs Windy Saddle. Make them back off and the crew falls back to their last block.

brief.penguins: The High Gate: the last wall before the region. Every point fortified, and Frostjaw takes the field.
brief.gangsters: The High Gate: the last block before the turf. Every point locked down, and Ridge Boss Kestrel steps in.

steps: Pay the shepherd for a guide
Take the sheep trail over the saddle
long_way.text: Big Jim's shepherd friend knows a sheep trail over the saddle. It's long and windy, but nobody guards it.
long_way.text_gang: A shepherd up the valley runs sheep over the saddle every week. Pay her for the trip and walk up with the flock.

sense.penguins: A howl rolls down off the ridge, and the heather lies flat as if something huge just lay down on it.
sense.gangsters: Engines idle up on the ridge. Someone has a lookout on every switchback.

penguins: Siege (fortified points turn at half speed)
gangsters: Siege (fortified points turn at half speed)

intro.penguins: Golems have taken the quarry roads. Break their lines and the old cutters' paths are ours.
intro.gangsters: A crew runs the quarry like a fort: crushers, floodlights, guards on every ledge. Shut it down, pit by pit.

won.penguins: The quarry falls quiet. Somewhere below, a golem sets its hammer down.
won.gangsters: The crushers go quiet. The quarry workers come back to their own jobs, and nobody takes a cut.

brief.penguins: A quick clash at Rubble Gate. Take the points and their line breaks.
brief.gangsters: Their lookouts hold Rubble Gate. Take the corners and they pull out.

nodes.name: Crane Pit
nodes.brief: Abandoned stores. Take the supplies for the next fight, or share them with the locals for morale.

brief.gangsters: Crusher Kade runs Crusher House. Make them back off and the crew falls back to their last block.

brief.penguins: Foreman's Hut is dug in and fortified: their points take twice as long to turn. Bring helpers and a plan.
brief.gangsters: Foreman's Hut is locked down: their points take twice as long to turn. Bring the crew and a plan.

brief.penguins: The Deep Cut: the last wall before the region. Every point fortified, and Old Shardback takes the field.
brief.gangsters: The Deep Cut: the last block before the turf. Every point locked down, and Crusher Kade steps in.

steps: Pay the cutters' toll
Walk the old cutters' path into the pit
long_way.text: The old stone cutters still keep a path along the cliff. Pay their toll and they'll open the gate for you.
long_way.text_gang: The quarry workers keep their own gate at the back. Pay their union fee and they'll let you in with the morning shift.

sense.penguins: The ground rumbles. Rocks shift on their own, and something in the dust is breathing.
sense.gangsters: A rock crusher starts up with nobody at the controls. The quarry's taken, and they don't want visitors.

penguins: Siege (fortified points turn at half speed)
gangsters: Siege (fortified points turn at half speed)

intro.penguins: Fog, frogs and bog hags. Find firm ground, hold it, and walk the causeways into the marsh.
intro.gangsters: Smugglers run boats through the marsh at night. Find their landings, take them, and the causeways are ours.

won.penguins: The marsh mists part. The frogs sing you through.
won.gangsters: The marsh landings are ours. The frogs are louder than the outboard motors now.

nodes.name: Reedbank

brief.gangsters: Their lookouts hold Plank Causeway. Take the corners and they pull out.

brief.gangsters: Hold Boat Shed. Their cars keep dropping off more of them; keep at least one point until the clock runs out.

brief.penguins: Dry Hummock is dug in and fortified: their points take twice as long to turn. Bring helpers and a plan.
brief.gangsters: Dry Hummock is locked down: their points take twice as long to turn. Bring the crew and a plan.

brief.gangsters: Smugglers' Landing: the last block before the turf. Every point locked down, and Smuggler Queen Rook steps in.

steps: Hire a flat-bottom boat
Pole through the reeds at dawn
long_way.text: A frog-catcher hires out a flat-bottom boat. Pole through the reeds at dawn, when the bog is quiet.
long_way.text_gang: A bait-shack owner rents airboats by the hour. Pay up and slip through the reeds before the smugglers wake up.

sense.penguins: Fog rolls over your boots and a hundred frogs stop singing at once. Something in the reeds is waiting.
sense.gangsters: Headlights blink twice across the bog, then go dark. That's a signal, and it isn't for you.

penguins: Defend (keep one point until the clock ends)
Siege (fortified points turn at half speed)
gangsters: Defend (keep one point until the clock ends)
Siege (fortified points turn at half speed)

intro.penguins: River serpents have the fords. Escort the ferry stores, take the weir, and the river is ours to cross.
intro.gangsters: Every bridge over the river has a car parked across it. Clear the bridges and the river roads open.

won.penguins: The weir is open and the river runs easy. Fish jump all the way upstream.
won.gangsters: The bridges are clear. Trucks roll across the river again, and nobody pays a toll.

nodes.name: Ferry Steps
nodes.brief: Abandoned stores. Take the supplies for the next fight, or share them with the locals for morale.

brief.gangsters: Toll Man Dukes runs Bridge Two. Make them back off and the crew falls back to their last block.

brief.penguins: Ford of Stones is dug in and fortified: their points take twice as long to turn. Bring helpers and a plan.
brief.gangsters: Ford of Stones is locked down: their points take twice as long to turn. Bring the crew and a plan.

brief.gangsters: The Weir: the last block before the turf. Every point locked down, and Toll Man Dukes steps in.

steps: Pay the ferry keeper
Cross on the night ferry
long_way.text: The ferry keeper still runs one boat at night. Pay the fare and cross while the river sleeps.
long_way.text_gang: The ferry still runs one late boat. Pay the fare and cross while the bridge crews are changing shifts.

sense.penguins: For a moment the river runs the wrong way. Grump tracks line both banks.
sense.gangsters: Every bridge has a car parked across it with the engine running.

gangsters: Siege (fortified points turn at half speed)

intro.penguins: The ruins have guardians, and the guardians have never let anyone in. Be the first.
intro.gangsters: Someone turned the old ruins into a fortress: floodlights, fences, a guard at every arch. Get in where nobody has.

won.penguins: The guardians lower their stone heads. The arch is open.
won.gangsters: The floodlights go dark one by one. The ruins are quiet, and they belong to everyone again.

nodes.name: Broken Stair
nodes.brief: Abandoned stores. Take the supplies for the next fight, or share them with the locals for morale.

brief.penguins: Our supply crystal sled has to reach Shard Crown. Walk with it: it only rolls with friends beside it and no foes on it.
brief.gangsters: Our supply truck has to reach Spike Gate. Stay with it: it only rolls with the crew beside it and nobody in the way.

brief.penguins: Gloomcrown holds Hall of Pillars. Turn the captain back and the rest will scatter, back to their gate.
brief.gangsters: The Curator runs Hall of Pillars. Make them back off and the crew falls back to their last block.

nodes.name: Scribes' Rest
nodes.brief: A sheltered spot to rest. Morale recovers here, and a camp you hold lets you rest again tomorrow.

brief.penguins: Hold Toppled Arch. Their gates keep pouring foes out; keep at least one point until the timer runs out.
brief.gangsters: Hold Toppled Arch. Their cars keep dropping off more of them; keep at least one point until the clock runs out.

brief.penguins: The Star Arch: the last wall before the region. Every point fortified, and Gloomcrown takes the field.
brief.gangsters: The Star Arch: the last block before the turf. Every point locked down, and The Curator steps in.

steps: Bring the scribe three old rubbings
Take the scribes' tunnel under the arch
long_way.text: An old scribe knows a tunnel under the arch. Bring her paper and charcoal for her rubbings and she'll lead the way.
long_way.text_gang: A night watchman at the ruins wants out. Bring him the supplies he asks for and he'll unlock the service gate.

sense.penguins: The old stones hum with a cold purple light. Whatever guards the ruins is wide awake.
sense.gangsters: Floodlights sweep the old ruins. Somebody has turned them into a fortress.

gangsters: Escort (walk the convoy to its point)

c_wastes.title: Across the Wastes
c_wastes.intro: Past the standing stones the land goes grey. Ember Grumps march in rows from the old outposts. Free the gate and the wastes are open.
c_wastes.won: The wastes gate creaks open. The grey land waits, quieter than before.

steps: Ask the standing stones' keeper for the old road
Walk the ash road by lantern light
long_way.text: The keeper of the standing stones remembers an ash road from before the Grumps. Carry a lantern and walk it at night.
long_way.text_gang: An old prospector draws you a map of a dry road round the patrols. It's slow going, but it gets you there.

sense.penguins: The air tastes of ash and the black stones hum. Out there, Grumps march in rows like soldiers.

c_sky.title: The Cloud Stair
c_sky.intro: Above the clouds the mountain keeps climbing. Storm Grumps crackle on every ledge. Climb it battle by battle, and bring them home.
c_sky.won: The sky stair is yours. The clouds part under your feet like a carpet.

nodes.name: The Sky Stair

steps: Pay Finargle's balloon fare
Float up past the cloud stair
long_way.text: Finargle's balloon goes up past the cloud stair on clear days. Pay the fare, hold on, and don't look down.
long_way.text_gang: Finargle's balloon goes up past the cloud stair on clear days. Pay the fare, hold on, and don't look down.

sense.penguins: The wind up the cloud stair sings a warning, and armour glints on every step.

c_station.title: Station Approach
c_station.intro: The station drifts dark, and shards crawl its corridors. Take it ring by ring.
c_station.won: The station lights come on, one deck at a time. Somebody left the radio playing.

nodes.name: Docking Ring

steps: Help Coldy fix the old shuttle

long_way.text_gang: Coldy thinks the old shuttle still flies. Help fix it and you can dock at the back airlock, where nobody's looking.

sense.penguins: A cold hum comes down from the station, and its lights blink in Grump colours.

c_jungle.title: Green Planet Landing
c_jungle.intro: The green planet's jungle is thick with shards. Cut a way in, one clearing at a time.
c_jungle.won: The jungle opens. The giant flowers turn to watch you pass, and they seem pleased.

sense.penguins: The green planet's trees lean toward you, and the shadows under them move.

c_colony_coral.title: Reef Rescue
c_colony_coral.intro: The coral colony is cut off by crabs and serpents. Fight your way across the reef to reach them.
c_colony_coral.won: The reef gate opens. The merkitties are waving from the shore.

steps: Pay the boatman

long_way.text_gang: At high tide a boat can slip round the reef. The boatman knows when. Pay him and sail round.

sense.penguins: The reef glows the wrong colour, and every fish has gone quiet.

c_colony_ice.title: Frozen Isle Landing
c_colony_ice.intro: Hollow Winter has frozen the island solid. Break the ice walls and reach the colony.
c_colony_ice.won: The ice gate cracks and melts. The colony sends out hot cocoa.

sense.penguins: Frost cracks across the water toward you, and the ice groans like a giant waking up.

c_colony_ember.title: Ember Isle Assault
c_colony_ember.intro: The ember island smoulders. Ash hounds patrol the bridges. Cross, hold, and reach the last colony.
c_colony_ember.won: The smoke clears from the ember isle. Above it, real stars.

sense.penguins: Smoke hangs over the atoll and the sea hisses where lava meets it. Grump drums, far off.

c_countryside.title: The Highway Job
c_countryside.intro: The highway out of the hideout is watched by the President's lookouts. Take the road back, stop by stop.
c_countryside.won: The highway is clear. A trucker honks twice as he passes. That means thank you.

long_way.text_gang: A trucker is stuck at the motel with a flat. Bring him a spare tyre and he'll take you past the roadblock in his cab.

sense.gangsters: A roadblock of parked trucks. Somebody whistles, and three more doors open.

c_docks.title: Dockside Push
c_docks.intro: The docks are the President's front door. Every pier is guarded. Take them one by one.
c_docks.won: The harbour gate is yours. The gulls sound like they're laughing at somebody else for once.

steps: Pay the harbour pilot

long_way.text_gang: A harbour pilot owes Sal a favour, almost. Pay the rest and come in with the fishing boats at dawn.

sense.gangsters: Crates move with nobody carrying them, and every crane on the docks has a lookout.

c_neon.title: Neon Nights
c_neon.intro: Every block in Neon answers to a sign, and every sign answers to the President. Take the blocks back, street by street.
c_neon.won: The neon gate flickers to your colours. The whole street hums along.

nodes.name: Noodle Row
nodes.brief: Their lookouts hold Noodle Row. Take the corners and they pull out.

nodes.name: Arcade Alley
nodes.brief: Abandoned stores. Take the supplies for the next fight, or share them with the locals for morale.

nodes.name: Karaoke Box
nodes.brief: Hold Karaoke Box. Their cars keep dropping off more of them; keep at least one point until the clock runs out.

nodes.name: Rooftop Garden
nodes.brief: Our supply truck has to reach Signal Tower. Stay with it: it only rolls with the crew beside it and nobody in the way.

nodes.name: Signal Bridge
nodes.brief: A sheltered spot to rest. Morale recovers here, and a camp you hold lets you rest again tomorrow.

nodes.name: The Neon Gate
nodes.brief: The Neon Gate: the last block before the turf. Every point locked down, and Neon Sable steps in.

steps: Fix the arcade owner's sign
Walk through the back of the arcade
long_way.text: The arcade owner's sign keeps blowing a fuse. Fix it and she'll let you through the back door onto the next block.
long_way.text_gang: The arcade owner's sign keeps blowing a fuse. Fix it and she'll let you through the back door onto the next block.

sense.gangsters: The neon flickers in a pattern. Someone is telling the whole district you're coming.

gangsters: Escort (walk the convoy to its point)

c_uptown.title: Uptown Assault
c_uptown.intro: Uptown is all lawns, glass and guards. Take the plazas and the tower road opens.
c_uptown.won: The tower gate stands open. Up close, the tower looks smaller.

nodes.name: Lawn Terrace
nodes.brief: Their lookouts hold Lawn Terrace. Take the corners and they pull out.

nodes.name: Fountain Plaza
nodes.brief: Abandoned stores. Take the supplies for the next fight, or share them with the locals for morale.

nodes.name: Gallery Steps
nodes.brief: Gallery Steps is locked down: their points take twice as long to turn. Bring the crew and a plan.

nodes.name: Valet Ramp
nodes.brief: Valet Ramp is locked down: their points take twice as long to turn. Bring the crew and a plan.

nodes.name: Glass Atrium
nodes.brief: Mr. Gilt runs Glass Atrium. Make them back off and the crew falls back to their last block.

nodes.name: The Tower Gate
nodes.brief: The Tower Gate: the last block before the turf. Every point locked down, and Mr. Gilt steps in.

steps: Get a caterer's uniform
Walk in through the service entrance
long_way.text: Every party uptown needs caterers. Rent a uniform, carry a tray, and walk right in through the service entrance.
long_way.text_gang: Every party uptown needs caterers. Rent a uniform, carry a tray, and walk right in through the service entrance.

sense.gangsters: Private security on every corner, and every earpiece turns your way.

c_underground.title: Down the Manhole
c_underground.intro: Under Neon the tunnels go on for miles. Crawlers and the President's crews hold every junction.
c_underground.won: The pit door grinds open. Down here, your name echoes.

nodes.name: Drip Tunnel
nodes.brief: Their lookouts hold Drip Tunnel. Take the corners and they pull out.

nodes.name: Pipe Junction
nodes.brief: Abandoned stores. Take the supplies for the next fight, or share them with the locals for morale.

nodes.name: Old Platform
nodes.brief: Old Platform is locked down: their points take twice as long to turn. Bring the crew and a plan.

nodes.name: Rat King's Hall
nodes.brief: Old Pipes Mulgrew runs Rat King's Hall. Make them back off and the crew falls back to their last block.

nodes.name: Pump Room
nodes.brief: Hold Pump Room. Their cars keep dropping off more of them; keep at least one point until the clock runs out.

nodes.name: The Pit Door
nodes.brief: The Pit Door: the last block before the turf. Every point locked down, and Old Pipes Mulgrew steps in.

steps: Buy Sal's old sewer map
Follow the map through the dry tunnels
long_way.text: Sal still has a sewer map from the old days. It costs, but it shows dry tunnels the crews forgot about.
long_way.text_gang: Sal still has a sewer map from the old days. It costs, but it shows dry tunnels the crews forgot about.

sense.gangsters: Water drips, and under it, footsteps that stop whenever yours do.
